note: THE ANCHOR CONTRACT (cinatra#2826, epic #2784 S9m) — the drift alarm between the design pin, the executable DOM expectations and the anchors a capture is graded against. `digest` is a sha256 over exactly three inputs: the acceptance manifest's `specCommit` (read from the manifest, never from here — the copy below is a readable mirror), the `domExpectations` recorded below, and the capture requirement anchors recomputed live from scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-recorder.mjs. Moving the design pin therefore invalidates the digest by itself, and so does renaming an anchor, adding a host cell, weakening an observation or changing what a capture must observe. The only way back is an explicit re-ratification: re-examine the anchors against the drawing at the new pin and record the new digest by hand. `node scripts/audit/chat-hitl-acceptance-gate.mjs --print-anchor-digest` prints the recomputed value; nothing writes it, because a digest a script refreshes on its own alarms about nothing. The other half of the binding is src/lib/lifecycle/__tests__/anchor-contract-binding.test.ts, which asserts these `domExpectations` deep-equal the executable ones — so the code cannot move without this file, and this file cannot move without the digest.
